prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover shows scraping, a cracked corner of the bumper cover, and a dented rear door skin, which fits the reported sideswipe while changing lanes. The damage is mostly in line with the described impact, and the lower control arm area is undamaged. The proposed repair plan calls for panel straightening, refinishing of the door and quarter panel, and replacement of the bumper cover. The labor hours submitted fit the damage shown. The billing records show no repeated charges, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the file or the owner's records. Recommend approval of the repair plan as written.
